Frame-indexed aquatic movement and group-geometry analysis

aqt_frame_index_analyze.Rd

Computes descriptive image-pixel movement metrics when measured image timestamps are unavailable. Only consecutive recorded frames within one camera-local track yield displacement; gaps never bridge. No physical velocity, experimental event inference, independent biological fish identification, or reference-to-model ID matching is claimed.

Usage

aqt_frame_index_analyze(
  frames,
  observations,
  occupancy_bins = 8L,
  max_fish_per_frame = 200L
)

Arguments

frames

Data frame: data_path, session_id, camera_id, frame_id, width_px, height_px, time_s. Frames must be complete 0..N-1 in each scope; time_s must be blank or NA.

observations

Data frame: data_path, session_id, camera_id, frame_id, track_id, x, y. These are observed bounding-box centres in image pixels. The source-specific bounding boxes, confidence, and annotation status are preserved if present.

occupancy_bins

Integer number of image-normalized occupancy bins per dimension; 2..50.

max_fish_per_frame

Maximum individuals for pairwise geometry computation per frame; 2..200.

Value

A list of the original source rows, complete-frame coverage, adjacent-frame displacements, within-frame group geometry, observed occupancy, per-scope descriptive summaries and warnings; class aqt_frame_index_study.
